metaDescription: Order custom 13 oz cocktail glasses for your brand. Perfect for events and gifts. Call Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 13 oz cocktail glasses hit the sweet spot between a standard rocks glass and a larger wine tumbler, making them ideal for serving everything from martinis to old fashioneds at corporate events or client appreciation gifts. The 13 oz capacity provides enough volume for a generous pour without feeling oversized, and the sturdy glass construction accepts crisp screen printing or etching for your logo. Whether you're outfitting a company bar or sending branded drinkware to remote teams, these glasses offer a polished, professional look that stands up to frequent use.
